description: Header file defining SIMD-accelerated CRC32 functions for x86 and ARM architectures, including type definitions, function declarations, and inline implementations for hardware-accelerated CRC computations.

methods.name: CRC32_u8
methods.description: Computes CRC32 for an 8-bit unsigned integer with hardware acceleration if available.

methods.name: CRC32_u16
methods.description: Computes CRC32 for a 16-bit unsigned integer with hardware acceleration if available.

methods.name: CRC32_u32
methods.description: Computes CRC32 for a 32-bit unsigned integer with hardware acceleration if available.

methods.name: CRC32_u64
methods.description: Computes CRC32 for a 64-bit unsigned integer with hardware acceleration if available.

methods.name: V128_Load
methods.description: Loads 128 bits of data from aligned memory.

methods.name: V128_LoadU
methods.description: Loads 128 bits of data from unaligned memory.

methods.name: V128_PMulHi
methods.description: Polynomial multiplication of high 64 bits of two vectors.

methods.name: V128_PMulLow
methods.description: Polynomial multiplication of low 64 bits of two vectors.

methods.name: V128_PMul01
methods.description: Polynomial multiplication of high 64 bits of first vector and low 64 bits of second vector.

methods.name: V128_PMul10
methods.description: Polynomial multiplication of low 64 bits of first vector and high 64 bits of second vector.

methods.name: V128_From2x64
methods.description: Creates a 128-bit vector from two 64-bit integers.

methods.name: V128_ShiftRight
methods.description: Shifts a 128-bit vector right by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: V128_Extract32
methods.description: Extracts a 32-bit integer from a 128-bit vector at a specified lane.

methods.name: V128_Low64
methods.description: Retrieves the low 64 bits from a 128-bit vector.

methods.name: V128_ShiftLeft64
methods.description: Shifts packed 64-bit integers in a vector left by a specified amount.
